newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt share prices retreat slightly.
newsitem.headline: Egypt share prices retreat slightly.

text.p: Egyptian shares retreated slightly on Sunday with milling and cement sectors dominating turnover despite falls in some of their prices.
The Capital Market Authority (CMA) overall index closed 0.24 points lower at 287.52 while volume was 29.89 million pounds.
"For the last two months it's been cement and the mills," said Mohamad Hamed of Okaz Stockbrokers and Financial Consultants.
Upper Egypt Flour Mills dominated turnover, with 1.5 million pounds changing hands. The share closed 1.20 pounds lower at 68.80.
Helwan Cement was the second most active stock but it fell 1.30 pounds to 60.00 after shares worth more than 1.41 million pounds exchanged hands.
Heliopolis Housing and Development, which has dominated turnover in the past week after the government sold some of its stake on the bourse, brokers said, gained 3.88 to close at 348 pounds.
"Real estate generally has gone up a lot," Hamed said.
The firm had announced last week that it had almost doubled profits in the 1995/6 financial year to 61.35 million pounds.
East Delta Flour Mills also edged over one million pounds in turnover but closed down 1.35 pounds at 53.00.
Of the 62 stocks traded, 15 rose, 21 fell and the rest were unchanged.
The CMA index for openly traded firms rose to 438 from 434.81 points on Thursday while the index for rarely traded "closed" firms fell to 200.69 from 201.82 points.
